offers_products.reason: Revenue is from gaming, hotel rooms, food and beverage; retail shop and goods are incidental.

offers_services.reason: Casino gaming, hotel lodging, dining, spa and event hosting at Atlantis Reno and Monarch Black Hawk are services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual guests gamble, stay in rooms, dine and use the spa at its casino resorts.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Banquet, convention and meeting space is sold to businesses and groups, though a smaller part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from individual casino visits, hotel stays and meals, not contracts or subscriptions, though some guests return.

cyclical_demand.reason: Gambling, resort stays, spa and dining out are discretionary and easily cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical casino bets, rooms, meals and spa visits are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for casino gaming, hotel rooms and facilities, not primarily staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual gamblers and hotel guests, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns large casino-hotel resorts in Reno and Black Hawk, with continual reinvestment and expansion in properties.
